home_intro: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course on your phone and tap "{button}". At the event, scan the attendance QR code with that phone.
admin_launch_expired: This link from Moodle has expired. Open the organizer activity in Moodle again.
admin_embedded_text: Moodle opened this inside its own page, where your browser won't keep you signed in. Continue in a tab of its own.
admin_open_from_lms_text: Organizers get in by opening the organizer activity in their Moodle course. There is nothing to sign in with here.
scans_host_hint: Recorded automatically: someone scanned the attendance QR code this admin was showing
scans_lti_hint: Opened the Moodle activity and scanned the code from the page it opened, rather than with a linked phone
scans_shared_hint: More than one attendee scanned from this address
scans_again_hint: This attendee had already scanned earlier
scans_footnote: Neither flag is wrong on its own — attendees step out and come back, and many share one hotspot. A code that leaked looks like many attendees on one address who were never there in person.
qr_keep_open: This code changes automatically — leave this page open.
scan_prompt_text: This page opens when you scan the attendance QR code. The code changes every 30 seconds, so scan the one showing now.
scan_set_up_text: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course and scan the code from the page it opens. Or tap "{button}" there, and next time this is all it takes.
scan_expired: This code has expired. Scan the one showing now.
scan_not_confirmed: We could not confirm that was you. Try again.
scan_not_set_up: This phone isn't linked. Open the attendance activity in Moodle and scan the code from the page it opens.
enroll_open_from_moodle_text: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course. It sends you here, ready to set up this phone.
enroll_done_text: At the event, scan the attendance QR code with this phone's camera and your scan is recorded. You won't need Moodle again.
enroll_done_note: It only works in this browser. Clearing its website data, or setting up another phone, undoes it — then open the Moodle activity again.
enroll_choose: How do you want to scan the attendance QR code?
enroll_scan_text: At the event, open this Moodle activity and scan the code with this page. Works in any browser, and nothing stays on your phone — you just need Moodle each time.
enroll_scan_prompt: Point your camera at the attendance QR code.
enroll_scan_not_ours: That isn't the attendance QR code. Scan the one showing now.
enroll_camera_failed: We couldn't use the camera. Allow this site to use it, and try again.
enroll_camera_failed_embedded: Moodle's page may not let us use the camera. Continue in a new tab and scan there.
enroll_scan_expired: This page is too old to record your scan. Open the attendance activity in Moodle again, then scan.
enroll_embedded_text: Moodle opened this inside its own page, where your browser won't keep the link. Continue in a tab of its own to set it up.
enroll_intro_phone: Use the phone you'll bring to the event.
enroll_intro_browser: Set it up in the browser that opens when you scan a QR code (usually Safari on an iPhone, Chrome on Android). After that, scanning the attendance QR code is all it takes.
enroll_already_set_up: This browser is already set up. Doing it again is harmless and replaces the old key.
enroll_key_create_failed: This browser couldn't create a key. Make sure you're not in a private window, and try again.
enroll_key_save_failed: This browser wouldn't save the key. Make sure you're not in a private window, and try again.
enroll_problem_no_profile: Moodle didn't tell us your name and email address, which we need to set you up. Let the organizers know: the activity's privacy settings in Moodle need to share both.
enroll_problem_unknown_tool: This Moodle activity isn't set up yet. Let the organizers know: the tool has to be registered with the attendance tool first.
enroll_expired: This setup link has expired or was already used. Open the attendance activity in Moodle again.
enroll_bad_key: Something went wrong creating the key. Try again.
